name: Hawa Mahal
descriptor: Five-storey pink sandstone facade with 953 small windows.

identifyingCues.text: honeycomb-like facade of small projecting windows (jharokhas)
pyramidal five-storey front that is wider at the base

identity.text: Built by Maharaja Sawai Pratap Singh to allow royal women to observe street life without being seen.

visiting.text: Open daily 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Best viewed from the street in morning light.

conditions.text: Urban site on a busy Jaipur street. Desert climate: very hot and dry in summer, mild winters.

context.text: Part of the City Palace complex. Jaipur's historic city centre is a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 2019.
